infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The lens scan uses the camera and torch to look for light reflecting back off a hidden camera lens. Nothing is recorded and nothing leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: The magnetometer is used to detect nearby ferrous metal so the app can tell you where to point the lens scan.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Hidden Camera Finder to use the camera and torch to scan for hidden camera lenses.
